recognize_zh: 這是一張 PCR-SSCP 電泳膠片的投影片，不是型態學影像：Skin 與 LN 樣本和部分未標示的泳道出現分離清楚的條帶（代表單株性族群），Jurkat 細胞株為單株陽性對照，PBMC 為多株性模糊條帶的陰性對照。
features: Slide titled 'Analysis of Angioimmunoblastic Lymphadenopathy by PCR-SSCP' showing a polyacrylamide gel
Lanes labeled Skin (two lanes), LN (two lanes), several unlabeled sample lanes, Jurkat, and PBMC
Skin lanes show multiple discrete, reproducible bands in duplicate
LN lanes show fainter discrete bands; unlabeled lanes also show distinct banding patterns
Jurkat (monoclonal T-cell line control) shows sharp distinct bands; PBMC (polyclonal control) shows a diffuse smear with fewer discrete bands
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing single-strand conformation polymorphism analysis of PCR-amplified antigen receptor gene rearrangements (target gene not stated) in angioimmunoblastic lymphadenopathy. Lanes from skin and lymph node samples, run in duplicate, show discrete bands that are reproducible between duplicates, indicating a clonal lymphoid population, whereas polyclonal peripheral blood mononuclear cells give a diffuse smear and the Jurkat T-cell line serves as a monoclonal control. Bands at comparable positions in skin and lymph node would support involvement by the same clone, but the exact band correspondence cannot be confirmed at this image resolution. Such data historically supported reclassification of angioimmunoblastic lymphadenopathy as a clonal T-cell lymphoma (angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma).
